content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

Not necessarily. Research shows you can build similar muscle across a wide range of loads, roughly 5 to 30 reps, as long as your sets are taken close to failure (about 0-3 reps left in the tank). Lighter loads just cost more time and fatigue per set.

Heavy work still matters for your 100 kg bench goal, though. Strength is specific, so you need to practice heavy, low-rep benching. A mix works best: heavy sets of 3-6 on the bench, plus 8-15 rep work on accessories. 💪
